description: This file defines a controller class 'SaveNationalityController' within the OrangeHRM system that manages pre-render logic for nationality-related views, selecting between 'nationality-edit' and 'nationality-save' components based on the request attributes.

classes.name: SaveNationalityController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the preparation of the nationality component for editing or saving, depending on the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Controls the setup of the Vue component to be rendered, choosing between 'nationality-edit' and 'nationality-save' based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
